name: Learn All 12 Major Scales
instructions: Every major scale follows the same pattern of whole and half steps -- once you know the pattern, you can build any of the 12.
Focus on just one or two new scales today rather than trying to learn all twelve at once.
Compare the new scale's finger pattern to C major's -- most differ only slightly because of where the black keys fall.
Watch today's tutorial for all 12 major scales, even if you only practice one or two today.
